title: Ex-Employee Gets Fired From Work Then Refuses To Leave
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On June 29th, 2023. Officers received a call about an employee who had been fired refusing to leave after causing a disturbance among the employees. One of the employees stated that he had only been hired there for a week, and refused to speak to anyone while at work. While speaking with the police he claimed to be the store owner. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
